scope: Synthetic only; no manuscript reads or H/F pooling.

Within page and exact length group all lines whose two bodies are the same literal body. Secondary uses correct ending family. Keep concordant prefix rows pinned. selection: Coordinates selected before outcomes. Bodies used for grouping; no qok or prefix-driven optimization of pairing. This is an expanded conditional subset, not all possible corpus rearrangements.
score: Total sh*qok; exact integer dynamic programming of subset sums conditional on left-sh count, convolved across disjoint groups. Uniform conditional assignments; no Monte Carlo. One-sided Bonferroni8. Score-constant null=notestimable.
generators: Reuse frozen previous generators without changes; fresh seeds. 12pages x24lines x8origins; sparse6lines and independently varying bodies. Effects .45 or .15. Run old rectangle engine on same generated data as descriptive paired comparison, not another tuning criterion.
gates: Exact oracle and margin invariants required. Primary exact-body: each nuisance Wilson95 upper flag bound<=.05; strong, small and sparse positives lower power bound>=.80; nooverlap allnotestimable. Any failure prohibits manuscript scoring. Secondary reported separately. No revised thresholds after outcomes.
limits: Synthetic event engine only. Additive-logit nuisance exchangeability, not arbitrary interactions. Four preset position-pairs may discard useful support. H/F remain separate in any future application. No manuscript rescore permitted even if pass.
